tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, a new model enabling long, complex professional tasks with 1M-token capacity for internal use. Reported by Yahoo Finance Australia.
Khan, former FTC chair, warns that artificial intelligence self-regulation is a proven failure and urges legal action and oversight. Reported by Telangana Today.
DeepSeek and Huawei are teaming up to challenge Nvidia's software dominance in China. Reported by The Business Times.
Google Gemini was allegedly cited in a $69K crypto scam report, with the chatbot recommending a scam site. Still open, per Crypto News.
The Internet Watch Foundation reports a huge rise in artificial intelligence-generated child sexual abuse material in 2026, prompting calls for new UK artificial intelligence regulations. Confirmed by The Guardian.
